verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents delete capture, soft delete/history modes, data blocking/column hashing, and an MCP scope that can be restricted to read-only or expanded to read/write/delete, giving some control over data lifecycle and access. However, there is no explicit documentation of a data retention policy, configurable TTLs, or an end-to-end account/data deletion workflow for AI-native/API-driven use. Missing for 10: documented data retention/TTL controls, explicit account-level or dataset-level deletion API/workflow, and independent confirmation that deletion requests are honored.
